description: Source code for YarnCoarseGrainedExecutorBackend, a custom implementation of CoarseGrainedExecutorBackend for YARN in Apache Spark. It handles extraction of executor log URLs and attributes, and includes a main method to initialize and run the backend.

classes.name: YarnCoarseGrainedExecutorBackend
classes.description: Custom implementation of CoarseGrainedExecutorBackend for YARN, handling executor environment setup and log/attribute extraction.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point to initialize and run the YarnCoarseGrainedExecutorBackend.

methods.name: getUserClassPath
methods.description: Returns the classpath URLs for the executor, including cluster-specific paths.

methods.name: extractLogUrls
methods.description: Extracts executor log URLs from the environment.

methods.name: extractAttributes
methods.description: Extracts executor attributes from the environment.
